protocol.name: aqua_glass_v1

description.summary: Liquid Glass shapes for Aqua's own apps

protocol.description:
Lets a client place shapes of the compositor's Liquid Glass material on its surface: the same refracting, lit glass as the menu bar, Dock and Control Center. A shape uses one of the compositor's standard materials (sidebar, control, menu, panel); the compositor owns the look, so all glass on the desktop stays one standard.
Behind-content materials (sidebar, menu, panel) are drawn under the surface: the client leaves those pixels transparent or translucent. The control material is a clear lens drawn over the surface's own pixels (a toolbar button's rim refracts and catches light).

description.summary: destroy the manager (existing glass objects stay valid)
glass object for a surface (one per surface)
remove all glass from the surface

request.name: set_shapes
request.description: Packed little-endian records of six 32-bit values each: x, y, width, height and corner radius in surface-local logical coordinates as 24.8 fixed point, then the material (1 = sidebar, 2 = control, 3 = menu, 4 = panel). Takes effect at once. At most 32 shapes are used.
